title: Kestrel and the Signal
author: Zephyrine Pemberton
blurb: Juniper Delacroix, a pilot bonded to an AI that lies, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
